name: Askari Metals Limited
summary: Askari Metals Limited is a Perth-based mineral explorer founded in 2020 and formerly named Askari Gold Limited. It targets lithium, copper and gold in Western Australia, the Northern Territory and New South Wales, with wholly owned assets including the Yarrie lithium project, the Horry copper project, the Burracoppin gold project, the Mt Maguire gold and base metal project and the Springdale copper-gold project.
